plan.notes:
Per the 2026-2027 Texas A&M University undergraduate catalog: Modern Languages — German Option (BA). Prerequisites are not listed in the catalog's plan of study grid; consult course descriptions.
Catalog footnotes:
[grid1 fn1] At least three hours must be in MATH. Three hours may be PHIL 240 .
[grid1 fn2] GERM 101 and GERM 102 are prerequisites for intermediate GERM courses and will count as general electives in the degree plan. If you choose to enroll in a language you have studied previously without receiving college credit, you must first take a placement test. See the Foreign Language paragraph.
[grid1 fn3] Two-semester or one-semester sequence of Intermediate German is required. Select from GERM 201 and GERM 202 , GERM 221 and GERM 222 , GERM 204
[grid1 fn4] See the Minor Field of Study paragraph.
[grid1 fn5] See the Study Abroad Requirement paragraph.
